records.statement: Coinbase's Q3 SEC filing references an investment in Circle and fair-value remeasurement, but share count, ownership percentage and current fair value are not separately disclosed.

Coinbase product eligibility does not establish XRP collateral balances. The Q3 recognized derivatives-collateral table lists BTC and ETH only; recognized lending 'other crypto' is $9.903M aggregate; $3.285B unrecognized customer collateral has no token composition.
The $715.022M Q3 gain on investment crypto assets primarily reflects BTC/ETH fair-value remeasurement; it is not recurring trading revenue, XRP buying or new external capital.
Coinbase's 10.7% trading-volume market-share metric includes stablecoin conversions and a proprietary competitor set; it is not pure spot-exchange share.
Custody, listing and trust-bank announcements establish infrastructure but not token-specific AUC, settlement volumes or incremental XRP demand. LMAX collateral integration remains planned.

SBI shareholder, Visa and Orico programs distribute XRP, but eligible counts, redemption rates, inventory source, hedging and aggregate XRP credited are not public. Rewards are not automatically spot purchases.

SBI reports JPYSC outstanding and JPY10B short-term JGB backing, but JPY6.9B is lending applications, not executed loans. Initial distribution is account-restricted; public-chain migration is conditional.

BlackRock/JPYSC, Open Standard JPYSC/OUSD interoperability and SMFG's 5% participation in SBI Startale Marketing are exploratory or early-stage; no production settlement or XRP integration is established.
Japan's 2026 FIEA reform has passed and been promulgated, but general commencement is within one year by Cabinet Order. XRP's asset subcategory is not formally determined in reviewed evidence.
Tokyo SBIC East Japan is distinct from SBI Holdings. Its ChatGPT course is educational; no OpenAI partnership or XRP relationship is established.

Permission Coin ASK remains only a candidate. Coinbase Embedded Wallet is not an exchange listing; aggregator market caps/supply differ and reported volume is extremely low. No XRP relationship is verified.

The exact origin of 'actual capital' remains unresolved. The 1960 U.S. Congressional Record uses the phrase for the separate U.S. SBA SBIC program; this does not identify the user's original context or connect to XRP.
No exact Camilla Stephenson YouTube channel identity or exhaustive public-video inventory is verified. Dr Kamilah Stevenson and similarly named people are not assumed to be the same person.
CoinGecko and Liqwall XRP open-interest totals differ by about 2.75x. Keep provider-specific series; do not average until contract-level venue/multiplier reconciliation.
The October 30 reported ETF net outflow is secondary-reported and does not prove immediate spot sales or unhedged demand.
PR #1404 replaces main commits with 30-day artifacts and therefore pauses current Pages refresh. A separate approved publication design is needed.
PR #1405 is draft/unmerged; the unsafe Databricks token-input workflow remains on main until authorized review and merge. No token was accessed or modified.
Scheduler Tick retains contents:write/actions:write and Autonomous Resolver retains issues:write/pull-requests:write. Last tick fired zero entries; resolver created stale issue #1403.
No lockfiles were found in the checked root/code search; dependencies are broad lower bounds. Security-alert access returned 403/unavailable and full repository CI/vulnerability scan were not run.

PR #1400 is a fixed-horizon forecast/outcome ledger, not a trained prediction model. Walk-forward evaluation, baseline comparison, source-registry enforcement, calibration, drift detection and shadow evaluation remain incomplete.
OCC CAS status is Consummated/Effective on October 26, but operational start, service volumes, AUC and XRP-specific activities of Ripple National Trust Bank remain unknown.
The GitHub connector was used without accessing a local worktree. Local dirty/clean status is unknown; no claim of a clean worktree is made.
